verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec for the Gemini API. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Related items such as the Docs MCP server, which lets agents read request schemas in documentation pages, and JSON-schema structured output are different features, not a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
